review1.name: Fatima Al Mazrouei
review1.text: I specifically requested female cleaning staff for our villa. The team arrived on time, was extremely polite, and left our marble floors and kitchen spotless! Excellent service.

review2.name: Mohammed Al Suwaidi
review2.text: Our AC units were leaking right before Friday prayers. HomeCare360 dispatched a certified technician within 45 minutes. Cooling was restored quickly and billing was 100% transparent.

review3.name: Noura Al Qahtani
review3.text: Booking via WhatsApp was super convenient. The plumber showed his Emirates ID / Passport ID, wore shoe covers, and fixed the main drainage valve cleanly.

review4.name: Sultan Al Rashid
review4.text: Odourless pest control that worked wonders. The technician explained the pet-safe gel application clearly. Splitting payment via Tabby made it super convenient.

review5.name: Mariam Al Kaabi
review5.text: Repainted our 3BHK apartment in just 2 days. The workers masked all our furniture thoroughly and used genuine Jotun paints. Highest recommendation!

review6.name: Tariq Al Hashimi
review6.text: Professional service from start to end. The technician diagnosed an MCB trip issue efficiently. Very respectful of family privacy.

faq.title: Everything You Need to Know
faq.subtitle: Have questions about provider vetting, female staff options, or payments? Our 24/7 bilingual support team is ready to assist.

booking.q: How do I request female professionals for home cleaning?
booking.a: When searching for cleaning services or during checkout, toggle the 'Female Professional' option. We will dispatch certified female cleaning staff to your home.

verified.a: All technicians undergo background checks, Emirates ID / Resident ID verification, trade license validation, and hands-on skill evaluations.

cancellation.q: What is the cancellation & rescheduling policy?
cancellation.a: You can cancel or reschedule for free up to 2 hours before the appointment via the app or WhatsApp.

payments.q: What payment options do you accept? Can I pay in installments?
payments.a: We accept Cash on Delivery (COD), Apple Pay, Mada, Visa/Mastercard, and 4 interest-free installments via Tabby or Tamara.

weekendSlots.q: Are services available on Friday and Saturday weekends?
weekendSlots.a: Yes! We operate 7 days a week, including Friday and Saturday weekend slots and evening appointments.

guarantee.q: What happens if I am not satisfied with the service?
guarantee.a: Every booking includes our HomeCare360 Guarantee. If you're not completely satisfied, we'll re-do the service for free or issue a full refund.
